statements.text: On the filtering hypothesis, the phenomenal character of each quantum coherent system is a function of how it resonates with the zero-point field, stirring it into a unique set of phase-locked modes. Each subject draws its experience directly from the universal pool of cosmic consciousness in the field, by extracting a system-specific set of correlated resonance frequencies.
